001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004
005/**
006 * A trainer that can randomly move between connected rooms while the player explores.
007 *
008 * <p>Movement avoids teleporter rooms so wandering trainers stay reachable in normal map locations.
009 *
010 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
011 * @version 2026.05.08
012 */
013public class MovingTrainer extends Trainer {
014    /** The room where this trainer is currently located. */
015    private Room aCurrentRoom;
016
017    /**
018     * Creates a moving trainer with a starting room.
019     *
020     * @param pName the trainer name
021     * @param pDialog the room description for the trainer
022     * @param pStartRoom the first room occupied by the trainer
023     */
024    public MovingTrainer(final String pName, final String pDialog, final Room pStartRoom) {
025        super(pName, pDialog);
026        this.aCurrentRoom = pStartRoom;
027    } // MovingTrainer()
028
029    /**
030     * Returns the trainer's current room.
031     *
032     * @return the current room
033     */
034    public Room getCurrentRoom() {
035        return this.aCurrentRoom;
036    } // getCurrentRoom()
037
038    /**
039     * Updates the trainer's current room.
040     *
041     * @param pRoom the new current room
042     */
043    public void setCurrentRoom(final Room pRoom) {
044        this.aCurrentRoom = pRoom;
045    } // setCurrentRoom()
046
047    /** Gives the trainer a small chance to move through a non-teleporter exit. */
048    public void tryMove() {
049        Random vRandom = new Random();
050        if (vRandom.nextInt(6) != 0) {
051            return;
052    }
053
054        java.util.ArrayList<String> vSafeExits = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
055        for (String vExitKey : this.aCurrentRoom.getAllExits().keySet()) {
056            Room vRoom = this.aCurrentRoom.getAllExits().get(vExitKey);
057            if (!vRoom.isTeleporterRoom()) {
058                vSafeExits.add(vExitKey);
059            }
060        }
061
062        if (vSafeExits.isEmpty()) {
063            return;
064        }
065
066        String vRandomExit = vSafeExits.get(vRandom.nextInt(vSafeExits.size()));
067        Room vNextRoom = this.aCurrentRoom.getAllExits().get(vRandomExit);
068
069        this.aCurrentRoom.removeTrainer(this.getName());
070        vNextRoom.addTrainer(this);
071        this.aCurrentRoom = vNextRoom;
072    } // tryMove()
073}
